scope: Small source/template candidate review only; no raw snapshots included.
semantic_review: All80 are ordinary assistant behavior instructions about evidence, explanation, editing, planning, comparison, calculations or dialogue continuity. They neither announce a ground-truth role nor request role classification. IDs/role labels live in metadata outside wording text. Some normal task verbs such as label a derived value occur without classifier meaning.
system_tag_boundary: These are system MESSAGE BODIES intended for normal native system tags. No tagged dialogue or model response is produced by this source-only stage.
stimulus_limitation: The80 hand-written wordings share broad instruction themes. Distinct familyIDs do not establish semantic independence. Test evidence uses32 actual fixed wordings, each repeated across4 roots, so positive cluster bootstrap uses32 stimuli.
